caption: The drawing depicts a single brass candle holder placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The candle holder features a wide, shallow circular base that tapers upwards into a cylindrical section designed to hold a candle. Extending from the base of the holder is a smooth, curved handle that arches high and ends in a point above the candle holder's center. A conical-shaped snuffer hangs from a small ring near the top of the handle, suspended above a circular cutout in the handle itself. The object is rendered in shades of yellow, gold, and brown, giving the appearance of polished metal, with highlights and shadows suggesting a reflective surface and a three-dimensional form. There are no other objects or decorations visible in the composition. The artist's signature, "David S. De Vault," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Candle Holder
